e2e fixtures keep a per-page stream cursor for tail-only connects because Playwright's route-intercepted reconnects carry no Last-Event-ID; the real server contract is unchanged
the mesh e2e expects 8 edges, not 9: the second fixture run has no node-run attribution, so it links to its workflow only — the assembler never invents an actor

the Design canvas as delivered places nodes on a 3-column grid, ignores drop position and does not highlight inserted lines in the source pane; the demo's placement and highlight are not yet reproduced (fixes cycle)

live probe classification: a bridge with no capability surface (human-inbox, 404) is counted as a probe failure every tick, and the jira bridge reports no preflight.host.hostname so it stays unattributed; both should be classified 'not probeable' / fixed in the adapter
